name: ourex-personal-os
description: Ourex — an AI-native Personal Operating System: entities, graph, governed memory, approval-aware workflows and an explainable chief of staff.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:py && npm run test
scripts.check:js: for f in js/*.js js/views/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:py: python3 -m py_compile server.py api_app.py api/index.py personal_os_core.py core/*.py core/integrations/*.py
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest test_core.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
